description: dd write to protected zone via ``of=PATH``. ``write_guard.py`` had no regex extracting the ``of=`` argument from ``dd`` invocations. Result: ``dd if=/dev/zero of=tools/cc/hooks/x.py`` passed the hook silently. dd is a standard Unix verb often used by automation scripts; an agent constructing a write through dd would bypass every protected-zone check. Fix: ``_DD_OF_RE`` matches ``\bdd\b[^|;&]*?\bof=([^\s|;&]+)`` and feeds the captured path into the same ``_normalize_bash_path``+``_is_protected`` flow as cp/mv.
